comment: Board DTBs that bundles use, by stable id dN. Paths are relative to root; each DTB directory also holds a 'features' file with the same id, sha256 and features. d2/d3 (fallback line) and d7-d9 (default line) keep the rN of their directory; new DTBs take the next free number from d10 (scripts/host/rog5-bundle-registry.py add-dtb). docs/bundles.md is generated from this file and bundles.json.

d2.notes: Bottom USB-C stage A (5 V by hand); no cpucap, no SBU mux; the r160 default and the safe-r6/safe-r7 fallback DTB.

d3.notes: d2 plus only the memx node (fdtoverlay; the dts diff is exactly memory@34a000000, kept as dts-vs-platform-usbbtm-dtb-r2.diff). Fallback DTB of safe-r8.

d7.notes: 2-lane DP through the SBU mux, HBR2 link cap, MultiMedia1/2 playback-only, speaker DSP part names. Feature list read back from the DTB (not recorded at build time).

d8.notes: 4-lane DP on the side port; bottom USB-C stage B (RT1715 + TCPM, source-only 5 V). With k105 (no 0144) the RT1715 ALERT never fired.

d9.notes: d8 plus memx (no-map 64 MiB at 0x34a000000, the DDR that aborts on instruction fetch). Default DTB since r204.

d10.notes: d9 + l11off (PM8350C L11 antenna rail disabled by late cleanup)

d11.notes: RAM trial A passed: d10 + compose-memslim-dtb.sh stockcma (frees 0xcbc00000-0xd7ffffff, 196 MiB)

d12.notes: RAM trial B passed: d10 + compose-memslim-dtb.sh stockcma,ionpool (d11 + frees 0xedc00000-0xef7fffff and 0xf3800000-0xf9bfffff, 128 MiB)

d13.notes: RAM trials A-C passed 2026-10-01; default main DTB: d10 + compose-memslim-dtb.sh stockcma,ionpool,pil (d12 + frees modem 0x8b800000 256 MiB, camera 0x85200000 and cvp 0x85c00000 5 MiB each)

d14.notes: REJECTED, never in a bundle: the slot-B loader verifier (rog5-bundle-verify) refuses /reserved-memory/iris-iova (reserved-memory child without reg) when packaging main-k114-d14-261001a; superseded by d15 (same nodes, iris-iova as a root child). d13 + compose-video-dtb.sh iris-v1.

d15.notes: TRIAL: d13 + compose-video-dtb.sh iris-v2 (dts/qcom/sm8350-asus-rog-phone5-video.dtso): Iris v2 video-codec@aa00000 (qcom,sm8350-iris + sm8250-venus fallback, firmware qcom/sm8350/vpu20_4v.mbn), videocc@abf0000, /iris-iova (IOVA [0, 0x25800000), root child because the loader verifier refuses reg-less reserved-memory children); otherwise d13 byte for byte
